question: In triangle ABC, if the Euler line is vertical and passes through (3,0), (3,4), and (3,8), which point is the centroid?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Euler line contains: Orthocenter (H), Centroid (G), Circumcenter (O)

Points given: (3,0), (3,4), (3,8)

Middle point is centroid

**∴ Answer = (3,4)**
